name: Maestri
soft_passes: #3 silhouette reads generic 'three stacked windows'; the winking-terminal subject is interior detail, not outline
#5 broadly environmental-glass but top sheen + radial card glows + inner screen vignette are three baked logics
#6 brand ramp is a clean violet->blue analogous family, but literal RYG traffic dots add 3 semantic hues + wordmark tint
#9 Liquid-Glass vocabulary but effects hand-baked (contra HIG) and mixed with a literal window-chrome quotation
failures: #4 16px squint (critical): stacked cards + fine 3-stroke face + RYG dots + wordmark collapse to a dark rectangle with a colored fringe
#10 variant robustness: concept keyed to light canvas + white window + RYG dots + navy screen; dark/clear/tinted/mono lose layer separation and the glyph
#12 no-text: 'maestri' wordmark baked into the titlebar

palette.background: canvas #FFFFFF with #EBEBEB graph-paper grid (lavender #D1B9F6 under glow); violet card ramp #9F5FFB->#814CFB; blue card #1836F9

light_model: environmental glass, glow-driven: radial outer halos on violet/blue cards + top specular sheen on white window + inner vignette behind glyph; no single directional source; all effects baked in rather than system-applied
layer_stack: glossy white front window (#D9DBDD titlebar) + RYG traffic lights + 'maestri' wordmark
devices: terminal prompt reimagined as a winking face (> eye + smile arc + | cursor eye)
three receding stacked translucent window cards ('many agents, one canvas')
graph-paper canvas ground behind the stack
literal macOS window-chrome quotation (real traffic lights + wordmark inside the icon)
rhymes_hint: developer-tool terminal icons (Ghostty/iTerm/Warp) softened with rounded caps and a face; the current AI-category violet->blue glowing-glass-card family; Big-Sur framed-window motifs crossed with a mascot twist
notes: Source is a 1024x1024 web render, squircle-masked with transparent corners (alpha=0) — NOT a verifiable full-bleed layer set, so mask/full-bleed authoring can't be confirmed; treat #1 as soft. Effects (glow/specular/shadow) are hand-baked, which HIG explicitly warns against for Liquid Glass (system should apply them) — classed liquid-glass by vocabulary, not by clean Icon Composer construction. Strong subject-mining (terminal->friendly-agent face) is the redeeming signature; the icon reads beautifully at 1024 but fails the two sizes that matter (16px Dock/Spotlight) and won't survive dark/tinted/mono. Icon palette (violet->blue glow) coheres with the cover art (lavender/binary-grid hero, violet gradients) — brand-consistent.
